trial_court: CHC (Court via Video Conference), Ct. No.42
case_name: In Re: An application under Article 227 read with Sections 482 and 401 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

parties.respondent_defendant: Mr. Arka Pratim Chowdhury (wife) / State through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta

facts_of_case: Matrimonial discord between parties; husband filed petition under Section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act praying for restitution of conjugal right; wife filed false case to harass the petitioner.

legal_principles.principle: The court is not inclined to pass any interim order in the absence of advancement in the matrimonial discord.
legal_principles.held: Since investigation was started some time in February, 2020 and there has been some advancement in the meantime over the matrimonial discord between the parties, the Court is not inclined to pass any interim order.

legal_principles.principle: A court is not inclined to pass an interim order in the absence of a genuine dispute.
legal_principles.held: The Court is not inclined to pass any interim order.

outcome.final_order: No interim order passed; matter listed under 'Contested Application' three weeks after.

use_for_drafting: seeking interim order in matrimonial dispute
